answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 32559 Country: India Title: During Sa’ee (safa marwa), Is it necessary to climb upward at safa turning point of ground level corridor? Question: During Sa’ee (safa marwa), Is it necessary to climb upward at safa turning point of ground level corridor? Wheel chair person simply turns after one or two steps forward at safa turning point. Does safa hill start as soon as level ground starts to uplift ? Answer ID: 32559 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1185/744/H=1432) Sai' shall be alright in this state too. However, it is sunnah to go to such a height that the House of Allah is seen. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
